scope: First three original rows of each of eight publisher categories; 24 unique requests, including three reused. Not all 15011 rows and not an official quality benchmark.
full_file_supported: Explicit --full; no full-file inference claim. Default selects first three original rows per original category.
limits: Original publisher training prefix and fields were used with the documented substitute Qwen3.5-27B NPU service and chat transport, not the Dolly paper model configuration.
Response integrity does not establish semantic correctness or production representativeness.
